chunks: What was narrated by ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you turn around during an obligatory salat (prayer) before completing it, then repeat the salat (prayer) if the turning was excessive; but if you had already recited the tashahhud, then do not repeat.

key_terms.الِالْتِفَاتُ: turning away or looking away during salat (prayer)
key_terms.تَشَهَّدْتَ: you have recited the tashahhud in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Does turning around during obligatory salat (prayer) invalidate the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about turning during an obligatory salat (prayer). If the turning is excessive before completion, the salat (prayer) must be repeated, but if the worshipper has already recited the tashahhud, repetition is not required.
